第662章：现在心境稳不住
何元岳如释重负地点了点头，内心惊喜万分。
他重新坐回蒲团上，闭目凝神，试图让自己的情绪尽快平复下来。
可那双微微颤抖的手还是出卖了他内心的激动。
看着面前这个年轻得过分却又强大得过分的弟子，眼神里充满了欣慰和感激，
还有一种说不清道不明的茫然和恍惚。
今天发生的一切就像是做了一个不切实际的梦，
他害怕自己一觉醒来发现这都是假的。
谁也没想到，林枫竟然逆天到了如此地步。
不但个人的修为突破速度快到了让人无法理解的程度，竟然还能帮助别人抵抗雷劫。
这种能力要是传出去，林枫的价值将无限扩大，
扩大到足以让整个修真界为之疯狂的程度。
能帮人渡劫是什么概念？
对于那些卡在瓶颈上畏惧天劫的金丹巅峰修士来说，
这就相当于有人能帮你跨过这辈子最大的那道坎，让你平平安安地从金丹迈入元婴。
这种能力比什么破婴丹、什么天材地宝都珍贵一千倍，完全不是一个量级的东西。
想到这，何元岳的神色忽然变得格外严肃。
他睁开眼睛，用一种少有的郑重语气对林枫叮嘱道，
字字句句都透着关切和担忧：
“枫儿，关于你能抵抗雷劫这件事，千万不要传出去。

这其中的利害关系远比你能想到的要复杂得多。
若是让外界知道了这个秘密，你的处境就会变得极其危险。
不只是那些忌惮你成长的敌人会想尽办法除掉你，
就是那些看似和苍玄宗交好的势力，也未必不会动别的心思。
能帮人渡劫的人，整个修真界都没有几个，
你一个人就抵得上百个元婴高手。
为师不想看到你因为这身本事而被人觊觎利用。”
林枫当然知道何元岳说这番话是为了他好。
能帮人渡劫这种事，确实是太过惊世骇俗了。
如果消息传出去，的确事情很多，当然，林枫也并没有帮陌生人渡劫的想法。
他认真地点头应道：“是，师父。
content_en:
Chapter 662: My mood is unstable now
He Yuanyue nodded with relief, feeling extremely pleasantly surprised.
He sat back on the futon, closed his eyes and concentrated, trying to calm down his emotions as soon as possible.
But those slightly trembling hands still betrayed his inner excitement.
Looking at the young yet powerful disciple in front of him, his eyes were filled with relief and gratitude.
There is also an indescribable confusion and trance.
Everything that happened today was like an unrealistic dream,
He was afraid that he would wake up and find out that it was all fake.
No one expected that Lin Feng would go so far.
Not only is his personal cultivation breakthrough speed so fast that it is beyond comprehension, he is also able to help others resist thunder tribulations.
If this ability spreads, Lin Feng's value will expand infinitely.
Expanding to a point that is enough to drive the entire world of cultivation crazy.
What is the concept of being able to help people overcome calamities?
For those cultivators at the peak of the golden elixir who are stuck at the bottleneck and fear the catastrophe,
This is equivalent to having someone help you cross the biggest hurdle in your life, allowing you to safely step from the Golden Elixir to the Nascent Soul.
This kind of ability is a thousand times more precious than any Poying Dan or any heavenly material or earthly treasure. It is not something of the same magnitude at all.
Thinking of this, He Yuanyue's expression suddenly became extremely serious.
He opened his eyes and warned Lin Feng in a rare solemn tone,
Every word is filled with concern and worry:
"Feng'er, please don't spread the news about your ability to withstand the thunder tribulation.
The stakes are far more complicated than you might think.
If the outside world knows this secret, your situation will become extremely dangerous.
Not only those enemies who are afraid of your growth will try their best to get rid of you,
Even those forces that seem to be on good terms with Cangxuan Sect may not have other thoughts.
There are only a few people in the entire world of cultivation who can help people overcome calamities.
You alone are worth hundreds of Nascent Soul masters.
I don't want to see you being coveted and used because of your abilities. "
Lin Feng certainly knew that He Yuanyue said these words for his own good.
Being able to help people overcome calamities is truly shocking.
If the news gets out, there will indeed be a lot of things going on. Of course, Lin Feng has no intention of helping strangers out of trouble.
He nodded seriously and said, "Yes, Master.
